Use the GitHub API and/or public HTML pages. Prefer HTML scraping over API to avoid rate limits. If using API, add `sleep 1` between requests.

Fields to determine:
1. `bilingual`: Read the README (or at least the first few hundred lines). Does it contain meaningful content in both English and French? Look for French words/phrases, French section headers, or a clear French translation. Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`Unknown`.
2. `readme_clarity`: Read the README. Does it clearly explain what the project is, who it's for, and how to use it? `Poor`/`Fair`/`Good`/`Unknown`.
3. `security_policy`: Check for `SECURITY.md` in root, `.github/`, and `docs/`. If not found, write `Missing`. If found, read it. If it contains real responsible disclosure instructions (contact info, how to report, PGP key, etc.), write `Present`. If it exists but is just a placeholder or links without real instructions, write `Incomplete`. Allowed: `Present`/`Incomplete`/`Missing`/`Unknown`.
4. `issue_response_quality`: Look at the 5 most recently updated open issues (API `issues?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc`, filter out PRs). For each, check if anyone other than the original reporter commented within the last 6 months (from 2026-07-13). If at least one issue has such a comment, write `Active`. If none, write `Stale`. If there are no open issues, write `No Issues`. Allowed: `Active`/`Stale`/`No Issues`/`Unknown`.
5. `release_notes_quality`: Check the Releases page (API `releases` or HTML). If no releases, write `No Releases`. If releases exist, check the latest few. If the description actually explains what changed (e.g., bullet points, changelog), write `Detailed`. If it's just a version number or tag with no description, write `Version-only`. Allowed: `Detailed`/`Version-only`/`No Releases`/`Unknown`.

Return the exact JSON object content you wrote to the file.

# Government of Canada Cloud Guardrails Checks for IBM Cloud

[](#government-of-canada-cloud-guardrails-checks-for-ibm-cloud)

This repository will provide the tools required to validate the minimum guardrails for the GC Cloud Operationalization Framework for IBM Cloud

## GC Guardrails

[](#gc-guardrails)

The following tables contains the list of [Cloud Guardrails](https://github.com/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails) You can also reach the IBM Cloud - [Government of Canada Guardrail Accelerator here: IBM Cloud Accelerator](https://github.com/ibmcloud-tech-canada/ibmcloud-gc-guardrails-accelerator)

Guardrail

Description

Enforcement

Link

01 Protect Root / Global Admins Account

Protect root or master account used to establish the cloud service.

Doc

[link](/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-ibm/blob/main/guardrails/01-mfa-validation/guardrail-1-mfa.md)

02 Management of Administrative Privileges

Establish access control policies and procedures for management of administrative privileges

Doc

[link](/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-ibm/blob/main/guardrails/02-management-administration-privileges/management-administration-privileges.md)

03 Cloud Console Access

Limit access to GC managed devices and authorized users.

Doc

[link](/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-ibm/blob/main/guardrails/03-cloud-console-access/cloud-console-access.md)

Create role-based account to enable enterprise monitoring and visibility.

Rego

[link](/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-ibm/blob/main/guardrails/04-monitoring-account/04-monitoring-account.md)

05 Data Location

Establish policies to restrict GC sensitive workloads to approved geographic locations.

Rego

[link](/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-ibm/blob/main/guardrails/05-data-location)

06 Protection of Data-At-Rest

Protect data at rest by default (e.g. storage) for cloud-based workloads.

Doc

Protect data transiting networks through the use of appropriate encryption and network safeguards.

Doc

[link](/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-ibm/blob/main/guardrails/07-data-in-transit/guardrail-7-in-transit.md)

Segment and separate information based on sensitivity of information.

Rego

[link](/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-ibm/blob/main/guardrails/08-segment-separate/guardrail-8-segment-separate.md)

Establish external and internal network perimeters and monitor network traffic.

Rego

[Link](/canada-ca/cloud-guardrails-ibm/blob/main/guardrails/09_Limit_egress_traffic/guardrails-9-network-security-services.md)
